description: For weather delay, this checklist records observed conditions, workability thresholds, lost or redirected activity, protection measures, and forecast outlook. Its supporting evidence includes on-site readings, weather source, photos, daily reports, schedule fragment, and mitigation record.

title: Weather Delay Checklist
use_case: Use the checklist during weather-impact documentation and recovery planning when the weather delay record must identify date, site, scheduled activities, contractual weather basis, crew, equipment, and affected milestones. Complete the applicable handoff for verified impact, notice status, schedule analysis, mitigation assignment, recovery plan, and claim-record linkage.
